topic: Motion graphs, ticker tapes, and wave energy
key_concepts: Position-time graph shapes show rest, constant velocity, speeding up, and slowing down
Horizontal sections on displacement-time graphs indicate an object is not moving
Changing slope on displacement-time graphs indicates acceleration
Velocity can be determined from displacement-time graph sections
Ticker tape dot spacing represents distance traveled in equal time intervals
Ticker tape patterns can show velocity and acceleration of a moving object
Velocity-time graphs can represent ticker tape motion
A wave is a disturbance in a medium
Waves carry energy away from a source
Waves carry energy but not particles of the medium
Greater wave amplitude indicates greater energy
Transverse wave parts include crest, trough, line of origin, wavelength, and amplitude
